verdict.rationale: The evidence points toward AI-assisted telemetry access: a first-party Bits AI docs page, an official MCP server that lets external agents work with Datadog data, and a ChatGPT plugin for analyzing experiments. However, the pack has only titles for these items and nothing describing natural-language questions being turned into real queries or charts. missing for 10: documented natural-language-to-query or chart generation (e.g. in Bits AI, logs or dashboards), details of what the Bits AI and MCP features actually return, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
